_comment: Single source of truth for EC2 pricing used to derive cost-per-token / cost-per-task. The EFFECTIVE hourly rate a run is charged is dollars_per_hour * discount_multiplier, further prorated by tp/gpus_per_instance for a partial-box (TP < gpus) run -- see pricing.py resolve(). Update rates here and regenerate the throughput summaries + charts; do not hardcode prices in scripts. `rates` records the alternative price points for reference; `dollars_per_hour` is the base actually used and `_rate_basis` states which point it is.

g6e.12xlarge._rate_basis: 3-year Reserved Instance (RI); discount_multiplier 1.0 (rate already reflects the RI)

p5en.48xlarge._rate_basis: on-demand base x 0.35 discount_multiplier (committed-capacity equivalent), effective 22.1536/hr
